---
title: "📝 T1 Collected Notes"
subtitle: "A COLLECTION OF THOUGHTS, OBSERVATIONS, AND LEARNINGS"
page-layout: full
listing:
  contents: posts
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  date-format: "MMMM DD, YYYY"
  fields: [date, title, subtitle, description, categories, image]
---

```{=html}
<style>
  /* ==========================================================================
     1. 데스크톱 및 전역 표준 톤앤매너 디자인 (Apple Charcoal & Blue)
     ========================================================================== */
  .quarto-post .title a,
  .listing-title a {
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .quarto-post .title a:hover,
  .listing-title a:hover {
    color: #007aff !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
  }

  .listing-date {
    line-height: 1.4 !important;
    text-align: left !important;
    font-family: "SF Pro Text", sans-serif;
    color: #1d1d1f;
  }

  .custom-year-heading {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin: 3.5rem 0 1.5rem 0 !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1d1d1f;
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-family: "SF Pro Display", sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .listing-categories .listing-category {
    border: 1px solid #e8e8ed !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: #86868b !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    font-size: 0.7rem !important;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .custom-year-filter-wrapper {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
    padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .filter-section-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  .year-filter-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .year-link {
    color: #86868b;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .year-link:hover, .year-link.active {
    color: #007aff;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     2. 📱 [모바일 고도화 패치] 박사님 맞춤형 4개 층 레이아웃 & 유격 소각선
     ========================================================================== */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .quarto-post {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: column !important;
      gap: 0.45rem !important; /* 각 층간의 균일한 마찰 유격 확보 */
      padding: 1.2rem 0 !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed !important;
    }

    /* [1층] 좌측 날짜 영역 - 잉여 공간 및 상단 썸네일 완전 소각 */
    .quarto-post .metadata {
      display: block !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      order: 1 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .quarto-post .metadata .listing-date {
      font-size: 0.82rem !important;
      color: #86868b !important;
      line-height: 1.1 !important;
    }

    /* Quarto 기본 썸네일 컨테이너 차단벽 작동 (중복 노출 방지) */
    .quarto-post > .thumbnail,
    .quarto-post .metadata .thumbnail {
      display: none !important;
    }

    /* 2층, 3층 메인 바디 구역 */
    .quarto-post .body {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: column !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      order: 2 !important;
      gap: 0.45rem !important; /* 🌟 [보정] 날짜와 제목, 제목과 태그 사이 유격 완전 통일 */
      margin-top: 0 !important; /* 기존 상단 마진 완전 연소 */
    }

    /* [2층] 포스트 제목 */
    .quarto-post .listing-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem !important;
      line-height: 1.3 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }

    /* [3층] 태그 칩셋 그룹 */
    .quarto-post .listing-categories {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      display: flex !important;
      flex-wrap: wrap !important;
      gap: 0.3rem !important;
    }

    /* [4층] 좌측 썸네일 + 우측 본문 설명글 결합 수평 행 트랙 */
    .quarto-post .custom-mobile-content-row {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: row !important; /* 가로 수평 축 정렬 */
      align-items: flex-start !important;
      gap: 0.8rem !important; /* 이미지와 설명문 사이 정갈한 안전 유격 */
      width: 100% !important;
      margin-top: 0.1rem !important;
      order: 3 !important;
    }

    /* 4층 좌측 슬롯: 정방향 컴팩트 썸네일 핏 */
    .quarto-post .custom-mobile-content-row .mobile-row-thumbnail {
      display: block !important;
      width: 76px !important;
      height: 52px !important;
      border-radius: 6px !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      flex-shrink: 0 !important; /* 뷰포트 압착 방어 */
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02) !important;
    }
    
    .quarto-post .custom-mobile-content-row .mobile-row-thumbnail img {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      object-fit: cover !important;
      object-position: center !important;
    }

    /* 4층 우측 슬롯: 말줄임 설명문 */
    .quarto-post .custom-mobile-content-row .listing-description {
      font-size: 0.86rem !important;
      line-height: 1.45 !important;
      color: #424245 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      flex-grow: 1 !important;
      display: -webkit-box !important;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2 !important; /* 2줄 제약 장치 */
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const posts = document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-post');
    if (!posts.length) return;

    const years = new Set();

    posts.forEach(post => {
      const dateEl = post.querySelector('.listing-date');
      const bodyEl = post.querySelector('.body');
      const descEl = post.querySelector('.listing-description');
      
      // 런타임 썸네일 주입 파이프라인
      const rawImgEl = post.querySelector('.thumbnail img');
      
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && bodyEl && descEl && rawImgEl) {
        const imgSrc = rawImgEl.getAttribute('src');
        
        // 4층 전용 수평 로우 생성
        const contentRow = document.createElement('div');
        contentRow.className = 'custom-mobile-content-row';
        
        const thumbDiv = document.createElement('div');
        thumbDiv.className = 'mobile-row-thumbnail';
        thumbDiv.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgSrc}" alt="Mobile Post Thumbnail">`;
        
        // 마크업 재배치로 4층 구조 안착
        descEl.parentNode.insertBefore(contentRow, descEl);
        contentRow.appendChild(thumbDiv);
        contentRow.appendChild(descEl);
      }

      if (dateEl) {
        const dateText = dateEl.innerText;
        const match = dateText.match(/\d{4}/);
        if (match) {
          const year = match[0];
          years.add(year);
          post.setAttribute('data-post-year', year);
        }

        if (dateText.includes(',')) {
          const parts = dateText.split(',');
          const monthDay = parts[0].trim();
          const yearNum = parts[1].trim();
          
          if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            dateEl.innerHTML = `${monthDay}<br><span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 400; display: inline-block; margin-top: 2px;">${yearNum}</span>`;
          } else {
            dateEl.innerHTML = `${monthDay}, ${yearNum}`;
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => b - a);

    sortedYears.forEach(year => {
      const firstPostOfYear = document.querySelector(`.quarto-post[data-post-year="${year}"]`);
      if (firstPostOfYear) {
        const heading = document.createElement('h2');
        heading.className = 'custom-year-heading';
        heading.innerText = year;
        firstPostOfYear.parentNode.insertBefore(heading, firstPostOfYear);
      }
    });

    const quartoSidebar = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    if (quartoSidebar) {
      const yearFilterContainer = document.createElement('div');
      yearFilterContainer.className = 'custom-year-filter-wrapper';
      
      let yearLinksHtml = `<div class="filter-section-title">Year</div><div class="year-filter-list">`;
      yearLinksHtml += `<a href="#" class="year-link active" data-target-year="all">All</a>`;
      sortedYears.forEach(year => {
        yearLinksHtml += `<a href="#" class="year-link" data-target-year="${year}">${year}</a>`;
      });
      yearLinksHtml += `</div>`;
      
      yearFilterContainer.innerHTML = yearLinksHtml;
      quartoSidebar.insertBefore(yearFilterContainer, quartoSidebar.firstChild);

      const yearLinks = yearFilterContainer.querySelectorAll('.year-link');
      yearLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          yearLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove('active'));
          link.classList.add('active');

          const targetYear = link.getAttribute('data-target-year');
          const allHeadings = document.querySelectorAll('.custom-year-heading');

          if (targetYear === 'all') {
            posts.forEach(p => p.style.display = 'flex');
            allHeadings.forEach(h => h.style.display = 'block');
          } else {
            posts.forEach(p => {
              if (p.getAttribute('data-post-year') === targetYear) {
                p.style.display = 'flex';
              } else {
                p.style.display = 'none';
              }
            });

            allHeadings.forEach(h => {
              if (h.innerText === targetYear) {
                h.style.display = 'block';
              } else {
                h.style.display = 'none';
              }
            });
          }
        });
      });
    }
  });
</script>
```
